About
Welcome to my personal website!
I am Professor of Sociology at the University of Texas at Austin. I study socio-economic transformations in a variety of settings, including financial and labor markets, workplaces, and digital platforms, with a focus on the production of inequality using statistical and computational methods.
I edit Socio-Economic Review, the official journal of the Society for the Advancement of Socio-Economics (SASE).
My current projects examine what large language models can reveal about labor markets, and what prediction markets tell us about how societies form beliefs about their own futures.
